text:
OncallBot: INCIDENT: PagerDuty alert (P1) — canary regression detected for model redwood-7b-v2 in us-west1. 15% increase in generation latency and +2.1% failure rate vs baseline. Root thread ts=2145001234

Sara L.: pinging oncall, I'm seeing alert noise in console. Are we mid-rollout?

Miguel R.: yep, started canary at 21:05 UTC, target 5% traffic. Initial deploy triggered automatic diff checks.

Aisha: I'm getting customer reports — single tenant svc-prod has errors in chat workers, 502s from inference gateway.

Chao: digging into logs. sharing live link: https://logs.internal/redwood/stream/abc123 (internal)

Ryan: quick stats from canary diff job:
```
latency_p50: baseline 78ms -> canary 92ms (+18%);
error_rate: baseline 0.7% -> canary 2.9% (+2.2pp);
quality_metric (BLEU surrogate): -0.6pt
```

Sara L.: that's > our threshold (latency >10% or error_rate >1pp). Paging oncall SRE.

Miguel R.: hypothesis 1: quantized kernel path regressed for seq>512. Hypothesis 2: K/V cache invalidation bug in runtime.

Chao: sharing grep of gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:06:04Z INF request id=xyz status=200 time_ms=115
2026-03-15T21:07:02Z ERR request id=abc status=502 model=redwood-7b-v2 exec_err=\"kv-miss\"
```

Aisha: customer impact assessment: 8 customers saw elevated error rates (incidents flagged in support). No data exfiltration.

Devops-bot: Canary diff job #458 created: https://ci.internal/ci/458/diff

Miguel R.: attaching minimal repro curl to trigger 502s:
```
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood/api/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2","input":"<long context>..."}'
```

Sara L.: action items: 1) pause rollout 2) pin traffic to redwood-7b-v1 for canary 3) collect full KV traces 4) start RCA thread.

Ryan: pausing rollout now via orch CLI: `redwood rollout pause --id=canary-20260315-7b-v2` => OK

Miguel R.: pinned canary route to v1: `redwood route pin --service=canary --model=redwood-7b-v1` => OK

Chao: exporting KV cache traces and uploading to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/2145001234/kv_traces.tar.gz

Aisha: I've notified support and CS, drafting customer message: short apology, mitigation steps, ETA for RCA.

Sara L.: starting timeline in the thread:
- 21:05 UTC: canary rollout started (5% traffic)
- 21:06 UTC: diff job flagged latency/error regression
- 21:07 UTC: first 502 observed
- 21:09 UTC: oncall paged
- 21:12 UTC: rollout paused and pinned to v1
- 21:20 UTC: KV traces uploaded

Miguel R.: next: run narrow repro, try rollback candidate v2.2.7 (older kernels) and see if failure reproduces. I'll run tests.

Ryan: if repro consistent, we'll do rollforward to v2.2.7 or hold v1 until patch. Agree? :thumbsup:

Devops-bot: Incident created in incidents tracker: INC-2145001234

Aisha: marking for RCA ownership: Miguel + Chao. I'll coordinate customer comms.

Chao: quick note — check quantization flags: `--q8_mode=true` was enabled in canary config. Reverting for test.

Miguel R.: update: repro shows error disappears when disabling q8_mode. Likely kernel regression with q8 path. Starting patch PR.

Sara L.: good. keep thread updates concise. We'll include canary diff artifacts and hypothesis matrix in the RCA doc once ready. :lock:

Ryan: thanks all. I'll keep SRE on call for 4 hours. Close on updates.
